name: Taproot
summary: Introduced Taproot, a merkleized alternative script tree that makes complex spending conditions indistinguishable from single-sig on-chain. Combined with Schnorr, this provides both privacy and efficiency improvements.
summaryZh: 引入了 Taproot，一种默克尔化替代脚本树，使复杂的花费条件在链上与单签名无法区分。与 Schnorr 结合，提供了隐私和效率的双重提升。
